data.name: Ketanraj
data.long_meaning:
Ketanraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ketana' which means 'jewel' and 'raj' which means 'king' or 'ruler'. This name is often given to a child who is considered to be the jewel of his parents' minds or the future ruler of their family.
In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is known as the 'Lord of the Mind' or 'Ketan Bhagwan'. This name is also associated with Lord Ganesha, the God of wisdom and knowledge.
